summary: Removes the redundant second argument `string.length()` from `String.substring()` calls when it's implied by the single-argument version.
rejectionReason: Reject as a duplicate of the existing Sandbox string-modernization.substring-to-end rule and Eclipse JDT's Substring cleanup (the source commit explicitly credits that cleanup). The raw candidate lacks the existing binding and receiver-evaluation checks, for example for next().substring(0, next().length()).
